final: WITH big AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, t.UnitPrice AS UnitPrice, t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds AS ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804), per AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM big GROUP BY MediaTypeName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM per) SELECT per.MediaTypeName, per.avg_price, per.avg_ratio, per.avg_ratio / overall.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
